sentences.text: Officer has been placed on the record with a copy of the Food Analyst report.

According to the analysis report Magnesium Patna High Court CR. WJC No.407 of 2020(8)
dt.26-03-2021 Carbonate (an anticaking agent) has been found in the given sample of the Pan Masala use of which is restricted in the said commodity.

Reference in this regard has been made to the Regulation 3.1.7 of Chapter of the F.S.S. (Food Products Standards and Food Additives)
Regulation 2011 and hence it has been held unsafe within the scope of Section 3(i)(zz) (iii)(v) of the FSS Act, 2006.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The second supplementary counter affidavit has also been filed in Cr.W.J.C. No. 40/2020.

Perusal of the affidavit sworn by the respondent no. 5 shows that he has taken certain action including that of initiation of a departmental proceeding against the police officers who have been prima-facie found acting negligently.
The Superintendent of Police, Gopalganj who is present in-person assures this Court that the disciplinary proceedings will be taken to a logical end within a reasonable period.

In view of this assurance and the materials which are now on the record, this Court dispenses with the personal appearance of the Superintendent of Police, Gopalganj and other officers including that of the Food Safety Officer.
Let both the cases be listed on 9th April, 2021 for consideration.
Patna High Court CR. WJC No.407 of 2020(8) dt.26-03-2021
In the meantime, learned counsel for the petitioner may file a rejoinder, if so advised, to the counter affidavits.

(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) arvind/-
U Note:
The ordersheet duly signed has been attached with the record.

However, in view of the present arrangements, during Pandemic period all concerned shall act on the basis of the copy of the order uploaded on the High Court website under the heading 'Judicial Orders Passed During The Pandemic Period'.
